job.title: Store Manager
job.description:
Imagine loving where you work again...
  • Imagine walking into a store where your team genuinely enjoys coming to work…
  • Where you're trusted to lead…
  • Where you're encouraged to have fun…
  • Where your wins are celebrated...
  • And where your employer invests as much in your career as you invest in your people.
That's exactly what this opportunity offers.
  
Here's the exciting part...
  • Take the reigns of a high growth store - with remarkable year-on-year growth and an equally exciting future ahead.
  • Work for a retailer that invests in people, not just stores. You'll be trusted to make decisions, backed by experienced leaders and given every opportunity to build a long-term career.
  • Forget being thrown in the deep end. You'll experience one of the best onboarding programs in retail, spending time across multiple stores before officially taking the keys to your own.
  • Be in a role, which will also give you some work life balance. You'll only work one Saturday a fortnight, with every alternate weekend off.
  • Love coming to work again. The culture is welcoming, down-to-earth, customer obsessed and built around trust, teamwork and celebrating success.
  • Be rewarded for what you bring. An attractive base salary, super, bonus and fully maintained vehicle reflect the importance of this leadership role.
The opportunity
This isn't simply about running a successful store...it's about taking a store and its team from 'great to greater.'

You’ll:
  • Have full accountability for sales, profitability, customer experience, operational excellence and, most importantly, your people.
  • You’ll build an environment where your team feels supported, challenged and inspired to become the very best version of themselves.
  • You'll recruit exceptional talent, develop future leaders, drive commercial performance, identify new opportunities for growth and ensure every customer leaves wanting to come back.
This is a role for someone who loves retail, thrives in a fast-paced environment and gets genuine satisfaction from seeing both people and performance flourish.
    
About you
You're already an accomplished Store Manager from a either a medium or large-format retail environment, and you've built your reputation by growing both the business and the people around you.
  
You'll bring:
  • Experience running a serious retail operation—with a sizeable team within a sizeable store as well as lots of customers and plenty of moving parts.
  • A genuine feel for the numbers. You know what's driving performance, where the opportunities are hiding and when something needs attention before it becomes a problem.
  • The ability to turn strong results into even stronger ones. This store is already performing exceptionally well, so your challenge is to keep building momentum rather than simply maintaining it.
  • A knack for getting the best out of people. You know how to set high expectations, build capability and create a team that genuinely enjoys coming to work.
  • Strong retail instincts. Stock availability, merchandising, inventory, wage control, shrinkage and customer service are simply how you operate.
  • The confidence to make decisions and back yourself. You stay calm under pressure, lead change positively and know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.
  • A leadership style people naturally follow. You're visible, approachable, decisive and never afraid to roll up your sleeves alongside your team.
  • Plenty of energy and ambition. You love retail, enjoy winning, celebrate success and are always looking for ways to improve both your people and your business.  
If you're looking for more than just another Store Manager role— somewhere you can genuinely belong, make your mark and build a long-term career—we'd love to hear from you.
  
For a confidential discussion, contact Gabby Symons on 0432 261 116 or gabbys@peopleequity.com.au, or simply apply now.

job.title: GM - Business Development
job.description:
What's in it for you?

This is a refreshing opportunity...as you're not joining a start-up searching for scale...you're starting with it.

Part of a major Australasian group, this substantial organisation operates at the intersection of healthcare, retail, pharmacy, technology and consumer services. Think major national footprint, established brands and channels, significant customer reach, rich healthcare relationships, digital and data capability - and the investment capacity to turn great opportunities into something meaningful.

The core business is established, successful and is continuously growing. Now comes the exciting part: leveraging that platform to create what's next.
New services. New markets. New partnerships. New business models. New revenue streams.

Reporting directly to the CEO and joining the Executive Leadership Team, you'll have the mandate to look beyond the traditional core business, identify where the organisation should play next - and then make it happen.

The opportunity:

This is not a traditional strategy role. We're looking for a commercial growth leader and dealmaker - someone who can see an opportunity, determine its commercial viability, find the right partner and negotiate the deal over the line. You'll leverage the organisation's customers, channels, brands, data, digital capabilities and healthcare relationships to unlock entirely new avenues for growth.

More specifically, you'll:
  • Identify and build a pipeline of high-value growth opportunities and healthcare adjacencies.
  • Explore new markets, services, business models and revenue streams.
  • Originate, structure and negotiate significant strategic partnerships and commercial agreements.
  • Identify potential new ventures, investments and acquisition opportunities.
  • Find the right partners and get the right people around the table.
  • Work alongside specialist M&A, finance and legal teams to take opportunities from concept through to execution.
  • Turn great opportunities into revenue, earnings and enterprise value.
About you:
  • You're commercially curious, entrepreneurial and naturally external. You build networks, open doors and make things happen.
  • Just as importantly, you'll thrive in a culture that values people who are humble, hungry and smart - ambitious without the ego, commercially sharp, curious and naturally collaborative.
You'll bring:
  • Senior experience across strategic partnerships, business development, corporate development, new ventures and/or commercial growth.
  • A track record of personally originating and landing significant partnerships, ventures and/or deals.
  • Evidence of creating new revenue streams, entering new markets and/or developing new business models.
  • Strong commercial and financial judgement.
  • The credibility to influence and negotiate at CEO, Executive and Board level.
  • The ability to navigate a large organisation while maintaining an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Energy, curiosity and a genuine appetite to be out in the market, creating opportunities and getting deals over the line.
Experience across healthcare, pharmaceuticals, pharmacy, diagnostics, medical services or health technology will be highly regarded. However, exceptional commercial growth leaders from consumer, retail, technology or other sophisticated service environments will also be considered.

If this sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you (Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity) so please apply ASAP.

job.title: Marketing Manager - Events & Communities
job.description:
The Role
This is not a typical marketing role, it's for a highly passionate leader who thrives on pace, energy and impact, and wants to be the driving force behind how a brand shows up in the room, not just on the page.
You'll own a busy national events calendar, spanning multiple well-known brands across the trade and consumer space, and become the single point of contact for how they come to life at every activation.

You'll be in the middle of it all: events, agencies, ambassadors, budgets and execution.

Why This Role Stands Out
  • A newly created role with real scope to shape how it grows
  • 30 to 40 major events a year across a network with huge reach
  • Genuine ownership of brand presence at events and activations
  • A new e-commerce platform build underway, with social playing a key role
  • Work with a broad portfolio of agencies, from stand builders to content specialists
  • Direct commercial impact, not just activity
This is a role centred around events and community leadership, not content admin.

About the Business

Its ASX-listed, with serious scale behind it and it has a large national footprint across both B2B and B2C channels. This is a business well recognised for setting the pace in its category, backed by a continued investment in resources. Currently doubling down on growth, there couldn't be a more opportune time to join.

What You'll Do
  • Own the major events calendar end to end: logistics, budgets, suppliers and on-the-day delivery
  • Act as the single point of contact for events, coordinating internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Manage a portfolio of external agencies, including a social-first agency handling day-to-day content
  • Own social media strategy and hold agencies and internal teams accountable for execution
  • Build and grow community engagement, working with brand ambassadors, influencers and sponsorship partners
  • Represent the brand at major industry events and conferences, bringing back fresh thinking on how the market is innovating
  • Support the rollout of a new e-commerce platform, with social playing a key role in the customer journey
What You Bring
  • A dedicated background in events, activations and project management (this is a specialist role, not a generalist marketing one)
  • A genuine, demonstrated understanding of social media as a strategic channel, with the confidence to brief and hold agencies accountable
  • Military-grade organisation: you anticipate what could go wrong and plan for it well before it happens
  • A natural people person who builds rapport fast and represents a brand well
  • Confidence working cross-functionally with agencies and multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Genuine energy for face-to-face engagement at events, including interstate travel
You move fast. You plan ahead of everyone else in the room. You make events happen; as you are always one step ahead.


If you're looking for a role where events, social and community actually matter, and you get to own how they show up, this could be one of your most career-defining moves.

APPLY now and your application will go directly to Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity.

job.title: Category Managers
job.description:
We're not looking for just another Category Manager or two...we're curating one of the strongest merchandise teams in the market.

Ready to help shape what's next? 
  • We're looking for talented Category Managers, who want more than just another role. We're looking for those who want to make an impact and become part of the team that's setting new benchmarks.
  • This business has national scale, well recognised brands, significant buying power and a genuine commitment to strengthening its merchandise capability with some of the best talent in the market.
That's exactly what this opportunity offers and there are multiple roles.
  • This isn't about maintaining the status quo. It's about joining a business investing in its future, where you'll have the autonomy to challenge convention, influence strategy and deliver meaningful commercial outcomes.
  • With genuine end-to-end ownership and the opportunity to work alongside exceptional peers and leaders, you'll influence far more than your category—you'll help shape what's next.

Why you'll love this role:
 You'll join a team that's being built with intent. We're attracting exceptional Category Managers and commercial leaders who challenge one another, share ideas and continually raise the bar. If you thrive in a high-performing environment and enjoy being surrounded by ambitious, commercially minded people, you'll fit right in.

Where you'll make an impact:
These are true end-to-end Category Manager roles where you'll own every lever that drives category performance.

You'll:
  • Develop and execute category strategies that drive sustainable growth.
  • Grow sales, profitability and overall category performance.
  • Manage ranging, pricing and promotional strategies.
  • Build strategic supplier partnerships and negotiate commercially beneficial outcomes.
  • Optimise inventory, forecasting and stock performance.
  • Identify market opportunities and deliver continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Partner closely with Planning, Supply Chain, Operations and Marketing to deliver outstanding results.
About You:
 You're not just someone who manages categories. You're commercially curious, naturally influential and motivated by making a genuine impact—not simply maintaining the status quo.

You'll come with:
  • Category Management experience in a retail, trade or wholesale business (B2B, B2C or both).
  • Experience across consumer/hard goods categories (and related). Whether you've managed power tools, pet accessories, office products, automotive parts or consumer electronics isn't what matters most—we're looking for exceptional Category Managers who know how to grow categories and deliver commercial results.
  • A commercial mindset, where your ability to grow categories, influence strategy and deliver measurable business outcomes is just as important as the industry you've worked in.

You'll also bring:
  • The commercial instinct to spot opportunities others miss.
  • The confidence to challenge thinking, influence decisions and back yourself.
  • A track record of turning category strategies into commercial results.
  • The ability to build supplier relationships that create long-term value, not just better deals.
  • The curiosity to ask "why?" and the drive to find a better way.
  • The judgement to balance data, experience and commercial intuition.
  • The credibility to influence stakeholders at every level.
  • The ownership mindset to treat your category as if it were your own business.
If you're excited by the opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now or contact Gabby Symons at People Equity for a confidential discussion via gabbys@peopleequity.com.au or 0432 261 116

job.title: Head of Retail
job.description:
The Opportunity
Own the network. Elevate performance. Shape what’s next.
  • A significant senior leadership role with full ownership, clear accountability and scope to influence outcomes across a national ‘specialty’ retail network
  • Join a business where customers are highly engaged and deeply connected to the product category
  • Lead the evolution of a service-led retail model, where team capability and customer experience are key differentiators
  • Be empowered to lift capability, improve consistency and embed a high-performance, customer-first culture
  • Build on strong foundations, bringing greater structure, alignment and performance discipline to support the next phase of growth
Your role
  • End-to-end accountability for sales, margin, costs and overall network performance
  • Leadership of 4 Area Managers and capability across the store network
  • Development and execution of a clear retail strategy aligned to business objectives
  • Uplift of in-store execution, service standards and customer experience
  • Embedding teams as trusted advisors delivering tailored, needs-based solutions
  • Optimisation of systems, processes and operating rhythms to improve efficiency and scalability
  • Cross-functional alignment across marketing, product and supply chain
  • Driving performance improvement, store turnaround and network optimisation
  • Building a culture of accountability, ownership and continuous improvement
Your Leadership & Style
  • Leads through a layered leadership structure, empowering Area Managers to deliver results
  • Balances commercial discipline with a genuine commitment to customer experience and service quality
  • Builds teams that are engaged, knowledgeable and confident in delivering tailored solutions to customers
  • Creates clarity in environments that may lack structure, establishing disciplined yet practical ways of working
  • Drives performance while maintaining a strong focus on people, engagement and retention
 Is This You?
  • Proven experience operating at Head of Retail, GM Operations, National Operations Manager or equivalent level within a multi-site retail environment
  • Leadership of geographically dispersed store networks through a layer of senior leaders (e.g. Area/State Managers)
  • A background in specialty or service-led retail, where customer engagement, product knowledge and service quality drive performance
  • Demonstrated ownership of a meaningful P&L — with accountability for sales, margin, cost control and overall network profitability
  • A track record of lifting underperforming stores and scaling high-performing ones through clear operational levers
  • Experience building capability at scale — coaching leaders, developing succession pipelines, and embedding consistent ways of working across a network
  • Strong commercial instinct, with the ability to interpret data, identify opportunities, and translate insight into action at store level
  • Confidence operating in both structured and evolving environments, where you’ve improved systems, processes and operating rhythms
  • Exposure to cross-functional leadership, partnering with marketing, merchandise, supply chain or digital to drive aligned outcomes
  • High emotional intelligence, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and build credibility quickly across all levels of the business
If this sounds like you, apply ASAP, or for further queries, please contact
Gabby Symons – Managing Director, People Equity, gabbys@peopleequity.com.au, 0432 261 116

job.title: National Business Manager - Trade Stores & Industrial Sales
job.description:
What's in it for you?
  • A Career-Defining Role: Take full ownership of a national network at a time of transformation and growth — your leadership will set the benchmark for years to come.
  • True Empowerment: A newly created, high-impact position with the freedom to design, implement, and refine the operational blueprint
  • Make Your Mark: Be the person who shapes the branch network, builds a scalable model, and leads the business into its next phase of national expansion.
  • Competitive Package: Set to attract the markets best:
  • Leadership with Purpose: Lead and mentor a national team, create a high-performance culture, and see the direct results of your influence across the network.
  • A Growing Business with Big Plans: Be part of an organisation investing heavily in operations, technology, and people — with strong backing for your initiatives.
  • Career Growth Opportunities: The size and scale of the business mean limitless pathways for high performers.
  • A People-First Culture: A supportive, collaborative environment that values innovation, engagement, and continuous improvement.
The Company
This is not just another industrial supplier — it’s a market leader and growth powerhouse, keeping the wheels of Australian industry turning. Supplying  critical industrial solutions, this organisation partners with manufacturers, maintenance providers, and trades to keep production lines running and customers moving.

With a strong national footprint, a reputation for service excellence, and the backing of significant investment, the business is doubling down on growth — expanding its trade and industrial network, upgrading systems, and developing a world-class team. Join at a time where your leadership will make a real, visible difference: you’ll have the resources of an industry leader, the agility of a business in transformation, and the freedom to build a network that sets the benchmark for the future of the sector.

The Opportunity:
This is more than an operations role — it’s an opportunity to formulate and deliver the blueprint for a national network. Reporting to the General Manager, you’ll take full ownership of business and operational performance across multiple sites, driving results, building capability, and creating a scalable model for future growth. You’ll play a key role in expanding market share in the industrial space, strengthening customer relationships, and embedding a culture where safety, service, and commercial success go hand-in-hand.

What You’ll Do:
  • Lead business and operational performance across a national network of branches - for the trade and industrial market.
  • Partner with sales teams to grow revenue, expand key accounts, and win in the industrial market.
  • Develop, mentor, and inspire branch managers and frontline leaders to create a high-performance culture.
  • Implement best-practice processes, leverage CRM/ERP systems, and enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Champion safety, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives
About You:
You are a commercially astute leader who thrives on transformation, growth, and people development. You have:
  • Multi-site leadership experience in industrial distribution and trade environments.
  • A track record of delivering revenue growth, operational performance, and cultural change.
  • Strong commercial and P&L management capability.
  • A passion for building engaged, capable teams and scalable business models
Why You’ll Love It:
This is your chance to shape the future of a national network and see the direct results of your leadership. You’ll have the freedom to innovate, the support of a highly engaged executive team, and the satisfaction of building something that lasts. A competitive salary package is on offer, along with genuine scope to grow with the business as it expands.
 
If this sounds like you, then please apply ASAP. For any direct queries or for a confidential discussion, please call Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity on 0432 261 116 or contact via email at gabbys@peopleequity.com.au.
